content.text: Now let's verify it builds correctly.

Project set up and verified to compile:

- **`pom.xml`** — `com.mysql:mysql-connector-j:26.7.0` (current latest per Maven Central), Java 17, `exec-maven-plugin` for running `App` directly.
- **`src/main/resources/db.properties`** — connection URL/user/password, externalized from code.
- **`src/main/java/com/example/db/App.java`** — opens a JDBC `Connection` via `DriverManager`, runs `SELECT id, name FROM users`, prints rows, uses try-with-resources for cleanup.

Run it against a live MySQL instance with `mvn exec:java` after adjusting `db.properties` (and creating a `users` table) to match your database.

Project set up and verified to compile:

- **`pom.xml`** — `com.mysql:mysql-connector-j:26.7.0` (current latest per Maven Central), Java 17, `exec-maven-plugin` for running `App` directly.
- **`src/main/resources/db.properties`** — connection URL/user/password, externalized from code.
- **`src/main/java/com/example/db/App.java`** — opens a JDBC `Connection` via `DriverManager`, runs `SELECT id, name FROM users`, prints rows, uses try-with-resources for cleanup.

Run it against a live MySQL instance with `mvn exec:java` after adjusting `db.properties` (and creating a `users` table) to match your database.
